name: commontool
description: CommonTool — Privacy-First, Zero-Upload Client-Side Web Utility Suite (18+ Tools for PDF, Media, OCR, Invoicing, Finance, Academic & Developer Workflows)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:commontool,firestore:rules,auth --project memory-2b328
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions --project memory-2b328
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npm run build:functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --project memory-2b328
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:commontool --project memory-2b328
